description: Estimated population of 100 m mesh cells, apportioning the 250 m mesh population of the 2020 Census by building floor area (Akira Nishizawa, GTFS-GIS.jp). Total population and population by age group for 4,979,919 cells across Japan, one polygon row per cell.

table:columns.name: mesh_code
table:columns.description: Original column: Meshcode. 100 m mesh code (10-digit string) - the 8-digit tertiary mesh (about 1 km) code followed by one digit each for the row (latitude) and column (longitude) of the cell when the tertiary mesh is divided into 10 by 10. Unique per row.

table:columns.name: pop_total
table:columns.description: Original column: PopT. Total population (estimated; fractional). The population of the census 250 m mesh, apportioned to 100 m cells by building floor area. Can be larger than the sum of the three age groups (by about 2.93 million nationwide), probably because it includes persons of unknown age.

table:columns.name: pop_0_14
table:columns.description: Original column: Pop0_14. Population aged 0-14 (estimated; fractional).

table:columns.name: pop_15_64
table:columns.description: Original column: Pop15_64. Population aged 15-64 (estimated; fractional).

table:columns.name: pop_65_over
table:columns.description: Original column: Pop65over. Population aged 65 and over (estimated; fractional).

table:columns.name: pop_75_over
table:columns.description: Original column: Pop75over. Population aged 75 and over (estimated; fractional). Included in pop_65_over.

table:columns.name: pop_85_over
table:columns.description: Original column: Pop85over. Population aged 85 and over (estimated; fractional). Included in pop_75_over.

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.type: struct<xmin: double, ymin: double, xmax: double, ymax: double>
table:columns.description: Feature bounding box (xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax). The GeoParquet 1.1 bbox covering column, used to skip row groups in spatial filters.

table:columns.name: geometry
table:columns.description: The 100 m mesh cell as a polygon in EPSG:4326 - a rectangle of 3 seconds of latitude by 4.5 seconds of longitude, computed from mesh_code (identical to the shapes in the source shapefiles).

title: Simplified 100 m mesh population (2020)
attribution: "Simplified 100 m mesh population (2020)" (Akira Nishizawa, GTFS-GIS.jp, CC BY 4.0), modified
